Revisión de entrada

A detailed examination of customs entry submissions to verify the accuracy of information, classification, valuation, and compliance before goods are released.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Revisión de entrada?

In this glossary, Revisión de entrada refers to: A detailed examination of customs entry submissions to verify the accuracy of information, classification, valuation, and compliance before goods are released.

How is Revisión de entrada used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "La revisión de entrada detectó discrepancias en los valores declarados y activó una investigación aduanera."

Why does Revisión de entrada matter in logistics?

Revisión de entrada matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Revisión de entrada?

Revisión de entrada is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Revisión de entrada belong to?

In this glossary, Revisión de entrada is grouped under Customs. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A detailed examination of customs entry submissions to verify the accuracy of information, classification, valuation, and compliance before goods are released.

Operational example

Entry review detected discrepancies in declared values and triggered further customs investigation.

Localized term

Revisión de entrada

Localized example

La revisión de entrada detectó discrepancias en los valores declarados y activó una investigación aduanera.
